title: TopoPilot: Reliable Conversational Workflow Automation for Topological Data Analysis and Visualization
abstract: arXiv:2603.25063v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent agentic systems demonstrate that large language models can generate complex codebases from natural language prompts. Despite this progress, they present reliability concerns for scientific visualization due to invalid operations, subtle errors, and failure to resolve underspecified inputs. These challenges are compounded in real-world workflows that exceed the complexity of standard benchmarks. In this work, we introduce TopoPilot, a reliable and extensible agentic framework for automating complex scientific visualization workflows. We focus on topological data analysis and visualization as a primary use case, while designing the framework to generalize to broader visualization domains. TopoPilot employs a two-agent architecture: an orchestrator translates user prompts into workflows composed of atomic backend actions, while a verifier evaluates workflows prior to execution. translated_title: TopoPilot：面向拓扑数据分析与可视化的可靠对话式工作流自动化
translated_abstract: 近期的智能体系统表明，大型语言模型能够根据自然语言提示生成复杂的代码库。尽管取得了这一进展，但由于无效操作、隐蔽错误以及无法处理欠明确的输入，这些系统在科学可视化方面存在可靠性隐患。在超出标准基准复杂度的真实世界工作流中，这些挑战进一步加剧。在本工作中，我们提出了TopoPilot，一个可靠且可扩展的智能体框架，用于自动化复杂的科学可视化工作流。我们以拓扑数据分析与可视化作为主要应用场景，同时将该框架设计为可推广至更广泛的可视化领域。TopoPilot采用双智能体架构：编排器将用户提示转换为由原子后端操作组成的工作流，而验证器在工作流执行之前对其进行评估。其模块化设计将各组件相互隔离……
tldr: 提出了TopoPilot——一个采用“编排器+验证器”双智能体架构的可靠智能体框架，用于自动化拓扑数据分析与可视化等复杂科学可视化工作流。
en_tdlr: TopoPilot is a reliable and extensible agentic framework with a two-agent architecture (an orchestrator and a verifier) that automates complex scientific visualization workflows, with topological data analysis and visualization as its primary use case.
